items.title: Which of the seven combinations is recommended?
assumptions: Two developers are building for the November 12 submission deadline.
All ten optional sponsors are a user requirement.
A working general reliability engine has not been established by the supplied research.

queries.summary: The recommendation favors an Assembly-led product with a bounded authorization module and isolated reliability harness. It is an engineering judgment about scope and coherence, not a measured prize forecast.

source.label: Three user-supplied architecture analyses
files: Assembly Proof judge and company analysis
caveats: The supplied analyses are proposals, not implementation evidence.
Descriptions of individual judges do not establish their private preferences or hiring authority.
The language analysis proposes sharing production checks; independent test expectations must not rely solely on those same checks.

source.label: PayPal hackathon rules
caveats: No observed judge scores or eligible final-project count supports a first-place probability.

items.title: Which novelty claims survive the overlap check?

queries.summary: Spokbee describes constrained configuration and checkout, Warden describes a PayPal agent firewall, and PayPal describes mandates and agentic-commerce services.

source.label: Published product and platform descriptions
caveats: Public descriptions establish overlap; competitor implementations and event eligibility were not independently tested.
A shared record or hash alone does not establish global originality.

queries.summary: The reviewed abstracts discuss authorization consistency across commit, recovery and service effects. AID-Guard directly overlaps exact-request and ambiguity controls.

source.label: Undermind abstracts and primary arXiv pages

links.label: Formal analysis of agent payment protocols

caveats: The papers were not replicated and their complete experiments were not reviewed.
Their results are not evidence that Assembly Proof is correct.

items.title: What supports a small PayPal and ten-sponsor architecture?

source.label: PayPal hackathon resources and sponsor briefs
caveats: All ten roles in the answer are proposed integrations; account access and working implementations are unverified.
Sponsor count has no separate weight under the overall judging rubric.

source.label: Official PayPal SDK and Store Sync documentation
caveats: Store Sync requires supported merchant eligibility and onboarding; normal sandbox access does not establish access.
A sandbox merchant prototype does not establish worldwide readiness or measured loss reduction.

items.title: What do current participation and model evidence establish?

queries.summary: The retrieved overview listed 22,384 participants and thirteen named judges. Registration count is distinct from eligible final submissions.

source.label: Official hackathon overview
caveats: The participant count is a retrieval snapshot and can change.
No source supports guaranteed internships, unanimous approval or loss-proof operation.

queries.summary: Hugging Face documents grammar-constrained generation. Schema conformance does not independently establish that extracted product facts are correct.

source.label: Hugging Face official documentation
caveats: The Hugging Face connector returned UNAVAILABLE; official documentation was retrieved using Exa.
No model, dataset or deployed inference service was benchmarked for this recommendation.
Undermind returned research before reaching its free search limit, which resets October 27 at 16:30 IST.
